payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Limatus
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the 2026-10-20 audit of Limatus.

**Evidence / Fix** (one checklist line per finding)
- [ ] pyproject.toml:4 description is stale: "A diagnose-and-steer quality loop for AI-generated content."; update to the current product description.
- [ ] README.md:100 cites `limatus/packs/NOTICE.md`; the file is at `src/limatus/packs/NOTICE.md`.
- [ ] README contains an invented press-release style quote and an unverified claim that Limatus "runs inside Papyrus"; remove or substantiate.
- [ ] `develop` has diverged from `main` (15 commits ahead, 6 behind per `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...origin/develop`); reconcile per the repo's branch policy.

**How to verify**
`ls src/limatus/packs/NOTICE.md` matches the README path; `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...origin/develop` shows 0 on the main side; the pyproject description matches the README tagline.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
